# que0p

> que0p is a free, open-source queue bot for Twitch streamers who play games with
> their viewers. Viewers join a queue from chat, the bot draws players fairly, runs
> automated 30-second ready-up timers, skips AFK players, and tracks a confirmed
> lobby — with a transparent OBS overlay to show it all on stream. Works for any game.

Add it at [que0p.stream](https://que0p.stream) — one click via Twitch login, no
downloads, no setup. After adding, type `/mod que0p` in your chat.

## How it works

1. A mod opens the queue: `!qopen seq` (first-come first-served) or `!qopen ran` (random draw)
2. Viewers join from chat with `!qjoin` and check their spot with `!qpos`
3. `!qdraw [1-5]` draws players; each gets 30 seconds to `!qready` or the slot passes on
4. Confirmed players appear in the lobby; no-shows and skips are requeued automatically
5. Players who haven't chatted in 10 minutes are skipped on draw (AFK check)
6. `!qnext` starts a new round; `!qstop` closes the queue; `!qreset` wipes everything

## Key features

- Fair draws: sequential or random
- Automated 30-second ready-up timers with auto-requeue of no-shows
- AFK activity check on draw
- Persistent confirmed-player lobby across draw rounds
- Queues auto-close when the stream goes offline or after 2 hours of inactivity
- Free, open source, game-agnostic

## Pages

- [Website](https://que0p.stream): landing page with features and one-click add
- [FAQ](https://que0p.stream/faq.html): how the queue flow, ready-up, AFK check, and auto-close work
- [Active channels](https://que0p.stream/channels.html): channels currently running que0p
- [Live queue viewer](https://que0p.stream/queue.html?channel=CHANNEL): real-time queue page for viewers
- [OBS overlay](https://que0p.stream/overlay.html?channel=CHANNEL): transparent browser-source overlay, recommended size 340×620
